name: PDF Text Extraction Benchmark
description: A benchmark and evaluation suite for measuring the accuracy and robustness of text extraction from PDF documents across varied layouts.
reputation: A well-cited, task-specific evaluation suite in document-understanding/OCR research, often used to measure PDF extraction robustness across layouts.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on PDF/layout extraction; performance varies greatly with layout complexity and OCR quality; dataset originates from 2017 and may be limited in diversity compared to modern document corpora.
